items.t: GRIs hold at 5.9%; the 2018 increases averaged 4.9%
items.body: UPS announced its 2027 GRI (5.9% average net) on Oct. 23, 2026, effective Dec. 21, 2026. Its 2026 GRI, also 5.9%, was announced Oct. 31, 2025 and took effect Dec. 22, 2025. FedEx announced 5.9% on Sept. 18, 2026, effective Jan. 4, 2027, its fourth straight 5.9% headline. Its 2018 GRI was 4.9%, announced Sept. 18, 2017 and effective Jan. 1, 2018, and UPS's 2019 GRI (4.9%) was announced Dec. 5, 2018 for Dec. 26, 2018.

items.t: UPS 2027 surcharges rise faster than the 5.9% average
items.body: An analysis published Nov. 6, 2026 says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than 5.9%, averaging 9.1%. UPS's published rates show Ground residential going from $6.50 to $7.10, after $6.10 to $6.50 in the 2026 GRI and $4.45 to $4.85 in the 2022 GRI. New for the Dec. 21, 2026 effective date: an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers (amount not released), an Additional Handling minimum billable weight of 50 lb (40 lb in the 2025 GRI), and a 5% fuel surcharge on Small Business Rates.

items.t: Fuel tables: UPS's Nov. 16 change is its latest of 2026
items.body: UPS announced on Nov. 12, 2026 tables effective Nov. 16 that put Ground/Ground Saver and Domestic Air percentages 0.50 points above the Nov. 2 tables for the same band (diesel $5.53–$5.80: 28.50% to 29.00%). Other 2026 UPS table changes took effect Jan. 5, Mar. 9 (the third increase of 2026), Aug. 10 and Nov. 2; in 2025 they took effect Mar. 10, May 26 and Jun. 23. In June 2025 UPS and FedEx Ground fuel surcharges both reached 20%, a record; on Oct. 26, 2026, at an average diesel price of $6.28 per gallon, UPS was at 29.5% and FedEx at 29%.

items.t: USPS: 2026 off-cycle changes, and a fuel surcharge for 2027
items.body: USPS announced a temporary 8% increase on parcel base postage on Mar. 25, 2026, effective Apr. 26, 2026 through Jan. 17, 2027. On May 11 it announced a July 12 change of +11.8% on average for Ground Advantage Commercial. Earlier mid-year changes: July 2025 Priority Mail +6.3% and Ground Advantage +7.1%, and July 2024 Parcel Select +25% with other parcels unchanged. On Oct. 26, 2026 USPS said it will add a weekly fuel surcharge from January 2027, calculated as a percentage of base postage; in 2021 USPS noted no surcharges for fuel.

items.t: 2026 peak and demand rates exceed 2025 levels at all three carriers
items.body: FedEx announced its 2026 demand surcharges on July 22, 2026. For Nov. 23 - Dec. 27, Ground residential is $0.80 (2025: $0.65), Additional Handling $11.85 ($10.90), Oversize $117.25 ($108.50) and Ground Economy $4.05 ($3.55). UPS's 2026 peak Large Package is $96.25/$117.50 (2025: $90.50/$107) and Over Maximum Limits $530/$590 (2025: $485/$540). USPS's 2026 peak runs Oct. 4, 2026 - Jan. 17, 2027, stacked on the temporary 8%, with Zones 1-4 0-3 lb at +$0.50 in retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage, against +$0.40 in 2025.

items.t: New in 2026: lasting per-pound fees and cubic-volume triggers
items.body: FedEx added a Vietnam-to-U.S. import surcharge of $0.36 per lb for priority-class and $0.27 for economy-class services, effective Nov. 2, 2026. UPS's Surge Emergency Fee of $0.23/lb began Apr. 19, 2026, and both carriers' 2026 Middle East fees run until further notice. In 2025, international peak fees of $0.10 to $0.52 per lb ran in set windows. Separately, FedEx (Jan. 12) and UPS (Jan. 26) added cubic-volume tests, with Additional Handling applying above 10,368 cubic inches.
